name: Falco
description: Falco, Belgian accounting and Peppol e-invoicing: purchase and sale documents with their files, invoices received over Peppol, Peppol participant lookups, and the customers, articles and invoices of the Falco invoicing module. Mostly read-only; setting a purchase's payment status and Peppol invoice responses are installed switched off.
instructions:
## Falco
This connector uses the **Falco API** (docs.falco-app.be) of Falco, the Belgian accounting and e-invoicing application: purchase and sale documents, documents received over **Peppol**, Peppol participant lookups, and the customers, articles and invoices of the Falco invoicing module. It reads; setting a purchase payment status is a write, and sending a Peppol invoice response is installed switched off.

**Setup (two keys, both required)**
1. The integrator creates an application on the Falco developer portal (dev.falco-app.be), requests the scopes it needs (e.g. `documents:purchases:read`, `documents:sales:read`, `peppol:inbound:read`, `peppol:participants:read`, `customers:read`, `articles:read`, `invoices:read`) and makes it **Public**. Its production **Application Secret** (`as_live_...`) goes into `FALCO_APP_SECRET`.
2. The Falco customer (an administrator of the organisation, plan Expert Essential or Expert Premium) opens **API access** under their initials in the Falco desktop application, picks that application by its id (`app_...`) and generates an **API key** (`sk_live_...`) for their organisation. It goes into `FALCO_API_KEY`.
3. Install and run `falco_get_organization` to check both keys. The connector calls the production API, `https://api.falco-app.be/v1`; sandbox keys (`as_test_`, `sk_test_`) only work on the sandbox host and are refused here.

**Workflow**
- Supplier invoices: `falco_list_peppol_inbound` for what arrived over Peppol (sender, amount, due date, payment reference, bank account), `falco_get_peppol_inbound_document`, `falco_download_peppol_inbound_document` for the UBL. `falco_list_purchase_documents` and `falco_get_purchase_document` cover all purchase documents with their files; `falco_download_purchase_document_file` with `main`, `ubl` or a file id fetches one.
- Sales: `falco_list_sale_documents`, `falco_get_sale_document`; documents made in the invoicing module: `falco_list_invoices`, `falco_get_invoice`, `falco_download_invoice_pdf`; master data: `falco_list_customers`, `falco_get_customer`, `falco_list_articles`.
- Peppol reachability of a company: `falco_find_peppol_participant` with its VAT number, or `falco_check_peppol_participant` with a participant id such as `0208:0123456789`.
- After paying a supplier: `falco_set_purchase_payment_status` (switched off at install; replaces the status, so show the user the document and the new status and wait for a yes).
- `falco_send_invoice_response` (switched off) sends an accept, reject, query or paid message to the supplier over Peppol at once; before calling it show the user the document and the response and wait for a yes.

**Dates and amounts**: filters take `YYYY-MM-DD`. Amounts are strings in the document currency (usually EUR). Lists are paged with `page` (from 0) and `page_size` (20 to 200, invoices up to 100); ask for the next page while a page comes back full.

**Limits and errors**: 60 requests per minute per application secret (429 above that; wait and retry). Errors follow RFC 9457 with `title`, `detail` and `code`. 401 means a wrong application secret or API key, or a sandbox key on production; 403 means the key lacks the scope for that area (the customer grants scopes when creating the key); 404 on a participant lookup means the company is not reachable on Peppol.
prerequisites: A Falco developer application (dev.falco-app.be) made Public, its production application secret, and an API key the Falco customer generates for that application under API access (Expert Essential or Expert Premium plan).

FALCO_APP_SECRET.label: Application secret
FALCO_APP_SECRET.help: The production Application Secret of your application on the Falco developer portal (dev.falco-app.be), starting with as_live_.
FALCO_APP_SECRET.patternMessage: Paste the production application secret, starting with as_live_ (sandbox secrets as_test_ do not work on the production API).

FALCO_API_KEY.label: API key
FALCO_API_KEY.help: The API key the Falco customer generates in the Falco desktop application under their initials, API access, for your application. It starts with sk_live_.
FALCO_API_KEY.patternMessage: Paste the production API key, starting with sk_live_.

verifyHints.401: Falco refused the keys. Check that FALCO_APP_SECRET is the production secret (as_live_) of the application the customer linked the API key (sk_live_) to.
verifyHints.403: The keys work, but the API key lacks the scope for this area. The customer grants scopes when generating the key under API access.
verifyHints.rate_limited: Falco allows 60 requests per minute per application secret. Wait a minute and try again.

tools.name: falco_get_organization
tools.description: Get the Falco organization the API key belongs to: name, VAT number, Peppol identifier, address, IBANs, profiles, plan (expert_essential or expert_premium), invoices sent over Peppol this month and whether it is linked to accounting. Use it to check the connection.

tools.name: falco_list_purchase_documents
tools.description: List purchase documents (supplier invoices and credit notes) in Falco, newest first: id, number, invoice and due date, currency, amount, supplier name, VAT and company number, payment status (not_paid, partially_paid, paid), Peppol status, events and attached files. Filter by creation date, invoice date or supplier name; page with page and page_size.

created_after.description: Only documents created on or after this day, YYYY-MM-DD.

created_before.description: Only documents created on or before this day, YYYY-MM-DD.

date_from.description: Only documents with an invoice date on or after this day, YYYY-MM-DD.

date_to.description: Only documents with an invoice date on or before this day, YYYY-MM-DD.

sort_direction.description: Sort direction. Default: newest first for dates.

tools.name: falco_get_purchase_document
tools.description: Get one purchase document by id: number, dates, amount, supplier, payment and Peppol status, its event history and the list of attached files (id, type pdf, image or ubl, file name, size).

tools.name: falco_download_purchase_document_file
tools.description: Download a file of a purchase document: the main file (usually the PDF), the UBL XML, or one attached file. The file is handed over as an attachment.

file_identifier.description: Which file: main, ubl, the position of the file in the files list, or the file id from falco_get_purchase_document.

tools.name: falco_list_sale_documents
tools.description: List sale documents (sales invoices and credit notes, including those imported as PDF or UBL), newest first: id, number, dates, currency, amount, customer name, payment status and Peppol send status. Filter by creation date, invoice date or customer name.

created_after.description: Only documents created on or after this day, YYYY-MM-DD.

created_before.description: Only documents created on or before this day, YYYY-MM-DD.

date_from.description: Only documents with an invoice date on or after this day, YYYY-MM-DD.

date_to.description: Only documents with an invoice date on or before this day, YYYY-MM-DD.

sort_direction.description: Sort direction. Default: newest first for dates.

tools.name: falco_get_sale_document
tools.description: Get one sale document by id: number, dates, amount, customer, payment status, Peppol send status, event history and attached files.

tools.name: falco_list_peppol_inbound
tools.description: List documents received over Peppol (incoming e-invoices and credit notes), newest first: id, received date, invoice and due date, amount, currency, sender name, VAT number and Peppol id, payment reference, bank account, invoice reference, payment status and whether it is a credit note. Filter by received date, invoice date, sender or number.

received_after.description: Only documents received on or after this day, YYYY-MM-DD.

received_before.description: Only documents received on or before this day, YYYY-MM-DD.

date_from.description: Only documents with an invoice date on or after this day, YYYY-MM-DD.

date_to.description: Only documents with an invoice date on or before this day, YYYY-MM-DD.

sort_direction.description: Sort direction. Default: newest first for dates.

tools.name: falco_get_peppol_inbound_document
tools.description: Get one document received over Peppol by id: sender, amounts, dates, payment reference, bank account, invoice reference and payment status.

tools.name: falco_download_peppol_inbound_document
tools.description: Download the file of a document received over Peppol (the UBL XML as received). The file is handed over as an attachment.

tools.name: falco_find_peppol_participant
tools.description: Look up the Peppol participant identifier registered for a VAT number, to see whether a company can receive e-invoices over Peppol. A 404 means the company is not on Peppol, or the VAT number is not supported.

vat_number.description: VAT number to look up, e.g. BE0123456789.

document_type.description: Document type the receiver must accept.

test_environment.description: true to look on the Peppol test network instead of production.

tools.name: falco_check_peppol_participant
tools.description: Check whether a Peppol participant identifier (e.g. 0208:0123456789) is registered to receive invoices or credit notes. A 404 says why it is not reachable.

participant_identifier.description: Peppol participant identifier, scheme and value, e.g. 0208:0123456789.

document_type.description: Document type the receiver must accept.

test_environment.description: true to check the Peppol test network instead of production.

tools.name: falco_list_customers
tools.description: List customers of the Falco invoicing module: id, name, VAT and company number, language, e-mails, phone, contact, address and Peppol identifier. Search by name or VAT with q, or filter by exact VAT number or e-mail.

q.description: Text search in name and VAT number.

tools.name: falco_get_customer
tools.description: Get one customer of the invoicing module by id with full address, contacts and Peppol identifier.

tools.name: falco_list_articles
tools.description: List articles (products and services) of the invoicing module: id, descriptions, unit price excluding and including VAT, unit, category, type, cost code and account number. Search with q in reference and description.

q.description: Text search in reference and description.

tools.name: falco_list_invoices
tools.description: List sales invoices and credit notes created in the Falco invoicing module: id, number, type, status (draft, sent, locked), document and due date, customer, currency, amounts excluding and including VAT, payment, e-mail and Peppol status. Filter by type, status, customer, number or dates; at most 100 per page.

created_after.description: Created on or after this day, YYYY-MM-DD.

created_before.description: Created on or before this day, YYYY-MM-DD.

date_from.description: Document date on or after this day, YYYY-MM-DD.

date_to.description: Document date on or before this day, YYYY-MM-DD.

sort_direction.description: Sort direction. Default: newest first for dates.

tools.name: falco_get_invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice or credit note of the invoicing module with its lines (article, quantity, unit price, VAT rate, amounts), VAT subtotals, customer and supplier, payment details and Peppol status.

tools.name: falco_download_invoice_pdf
tools.description: Download the PDF of an invoice or credit note of the invoicing module. The file is handed over as an attachment.

tools.name: falco_set_purchase_payment_status
tools.description: Set the payment status of a purchase document to not_paid, partially_paid or paid, e.g. after paying a supplier. Replaces the current status; returns the updated document.

tools.name: falco_send_invoice_response
tools.description: Send a Peppol invoice response for a received document to its sender: acknowledged, in_process, under_query, conditionally_accepted, rejected, accepted or paid, with optional reasons. The supplier receives it at once and it cannot be withdrawn.

status.description: Optional reasons. status_reason_code is a Peppol OPStatusAction or OPStatusReason code (e.g. NOA, PIN, NIN for actions; REF, LEG, REC, QUA, DEL, PRI, QTY for reasons); status_reason is free text.
